verifications.note: MEE 2016-12-20 竣工环境保护验收合格函 (East section) lists the branch by name — '樟树～湘潭联络线' — among the five branches/trunk of the East-section acceptance, and gives 2014 throughput utilization percentages per segment ('干线、支干线和联络线输气量分别占设计输气量的83.6%、13.3%、15.9%、41.2%、14.9%和20.8%'), i.e. the branch was actively carrying gas at a measured share of design capacity in 2014 — this is a government post-commissioning acceptance filing, confirming operating status by direct context.

Hunan provincial government document states '2011年7月，西二线樟树—湘潭支干线建成投产' (in July 2011 the Zhangshu-Xiangtan branch of West-East 2 was completed and put into commercial operation) — an explicit, segment-named commissioning statement.

verifications.note: MEE filing describes the whole West-East Gas Pipeline 2 system, including the named 樟树～湘潭联络线 branch, as a natural-gas transmission project ('西气东输二线工程' = West-gas-East-transmission line 2; 设计输气量 = design GAS throughput figures given per segment including this branch).

resolutions.researcher_notes: Fuel type is unambiguous and stated directly in both segment-naming government sources — this is a natural-gas trunk/branch system by definition (西气东输 = 'west gas east transmission'). Recorded value 'Gas' confirmed.

verifications.note: '2011年7月，西二线樟树—湘潭支干线建成投产' — explicit, branch-named statement that the Zhangshu-Xiangtan branch was completed and commissioned in July 2011. Matches recorded StartYear1=2011 / StartMonth1=7 exactly.

MEE filing gives the East-section-wide rollout as '工程于2009年2月开工建设，2011年6月起分段投入运行，2012年12月全线建成投运' (construction from Feb 2009; the section began phased/partial operation from June 2011; the full East section — trunk + all 5 branches including this one — was fully commissioned by Dec 2012). This is a system-level (not branch-specific) milestone description; it corroborates 2011 as the year phased operations began across the section this branch belongs to, one month earlier than the Hunan doc's branch-specific July figure.

resolutions.researcher_notes: Primary support is the Hunan provincial document, which names the branch directly and states July 2011 commissioning — matches recorded StartYear1=2011/StartMonth1=7 exactly. The MEE national filing corroborates the year (phased operation across the East section, which includes this branch, beginning June 2011) but describes the section-wide rollout rather than this specific branch's commissioning month, so a 1-month gap (June system-wide vs July branch-specific) exists between the two sources; noted here rather than silently smoothed over. No conflicting date found elsewhere. verifications.note: '樟树～湘潭联络线管径660毫米，设计压力10兆帕，设计输气量40亿立方米/年' — MEE filing states the Zhangshu-Xiangtan branch's own design capacity as 4.0 billion m3/year (40亿立方米/年), listed distinctly from the trunk (300亿m3/y) and other branches in the same sentence structure. Exact match to recorded 4.00 bcm/y.

'设计输气量为30.0×10⁸m³/a，最大输气能力可达到40×10⁸m³/a' — Hunan document gives 3.0 bcm/y as the branch's 'design' throughput and 4.0 bcm/y as its 'maximum capacity'. The 4.0 bcm/y figure textually matches the recorded value, though the two sources use slightly different labels (MEE calls 4.0 'design capacity'; Hunan calls 4.0 'maximum capacity' and 3.0 'design'). Noted as a terminology nuance, not a numeric conflict — both documents state 40亿立方米/年 (4.0 bcm/y) for this branch.
